scripts.smoke: npm run report:clean && npx playwright test tests/LoginTest.spec.ts tests/RegistrationTest.spec.ts && npm run report:generate
scripts.smoke:headed: npm run report:clean && npx playwright test tests/LoginTest.spec.ts tests/RegistrationTest.spec.ts --headed && npm run report:generate
scripts.smoke:chrome: npm run report:clean && npx playwright test tests/LoginTest.spec.ts tests/RegistrationTest.spec.ts --project=chromium && npm run report:generate
scripts.smoke:firefox: npm run report:clean && npx playwright test tests/LoginTest.spec.ts tests/RegistrationTest.spec.ts --project=firefox && npm run report:generate
scripts.regression: npm run report:clean && npx playwright test tests/CategoryTest.spec.ts tests/CourseTest.spec.ts && npm run report:generate
scripts.regression:headed: npm run report:clean && npx playwright test tests/CategoryTest.spec.ts tests/CourseTest.spec.ts --headed && npm run report:generate
scripts.report:generate: cp -r reports/history allure-results/history 2>/dev/null || true && allure generate allure-results --clean -o reports
